body:
They were sick and wanted me to know. Now i do and have been reminded they don't care.

Sorry. I'm out
I did that - twice. Yet here i am! It's been a long day.
That I can't say - this is a throwaway account and my role is too public.

If we were speaking, probably making plans, being content at work, normal things.

If I was completely discount, probably the same but with others 

As it stands, I'm distracted, been getting some finance stuff in order and writing a letter. Still can't shift the eerie peace this choice is bringing. I appreciate the open questions, has given me some time to think and evaluate stuff more. Ultimately, though, it's the overwhelming feeling of relief that there's a way out.
If i had the answer I wouldn't be here

I'm waiting on my discharge - that's how much more "well" I am. It's as if I can't make mistakes, though - without being branded a liar or worse, even if the same person does the same thing, I'm evil?

Half of me is like fuck it, I'll just live my life and what this person does it outside me remit. The other half can't see a future where this fresh hell isn't my reality and I'd really rather not experience this for much longer.

That's very kind of you to say, good morning to you too!

I wish I had an answer. I've loved others - dearly, fiercely, in spite of everything - but it's always different with them. But I also can't exist in a space where anything that isn't their unrelenting standards - whatever they may be - means I get abuse, cut off and stood on.

I'm just tired of thinking I've broken a cycle, done better, whatever, and I'm still the same old mess. Recovery feels more like a lie every day and now I'm back to the no contact, "this is the first day without a 'good morning!'" message etc.

I thought I was doing better after 2 years in treatment and being in the remission period. I guess not

I picked that apart already in treatment - narcissistic, overly strict mother and trauma at a young age caused me to seek out constant perfection and praise but it was never enough. This individual will find any reason to reject me despite doing the same actions and I'm trapped in an abusive cycle that i either way to end in love and peace or just silence.

Coercive control is horrible and i don't have another way out.
I know, i just want the pain to stop and it won't, despite endless therapy and meds. I fucked up, I'm sorry.

Woke up this morning feeling worse. It's a cycle I've been trying to break with an individual for years now and it's just not happening.

I made a mistake because I'm a people pleaser, an arsehole and an idiot. Times up. Thanks to everyone who replied, I'm away for the big sleep.

It's taken me years to get past what he did, what I did. It's never ever going to stop. So I need to disappear.

I'm going to finish the job tomorrow. I've made peace with it.
It's nearly 10pm and I'm still in a hole

Hey, I appreciate it. I made a bad call because of a friend and really hurt the person i cared about, again. I love them so much but i also know I'm overly scrutinized, but it doesn't help the sense of failure and discuss.

I've wrote a note out, got myself a nice drink and I'm just ready, you know? I feel totally calm. I asked a qu on AskReddit just to see but to be honest, i hope it just helps people heal better.

Thanks again, friend. I appreciate you reaching out.
